runtimeEnforcement.approvedReferencePngDigests: Runtime-enforced by public-homepage-visual.spec.ts before screenshot comparisons.
runtimeEnforcement.derivedBaselineDigests: Runtime-enforced by public-homepage-visual.spec.ts before and after screenshot comparisons; baselines are re-derived from the approved exports and compared byte for byte.
runtimeEnforcement.perFrameAllowance: maxDiffPixelRatio per screenshot, read by the spec from this manifest.

sourceDesign.provenanceNote: Six PAF-201 frames exported through Pencil MCP Export at scale 1 and committed unchanged. Approved as one family. The app-wide locale/theme chips are not drawn in the frames: only their two rectangles are masked. No desktop frame exists, so no desktop image baseline is claimed.

comparison.viewport: CSS width = frame width, CSS height = frame height, deviceScaleFactor 1, viewport (not full page) screenshot; the spec first asserts the document is not taller than the frame and that the content height (last footer line + 32px) is within 2px of the frame height, so the last footer line is inside the capture.
comparison.environment: Chromium with the playwright.config.ts deterministic raster flags (--font-render-hinting=none, --disable-font-subpixel-positioning, --disable-lcd-text, --force-color-profile=srgb, --disable-skia-runtime-opts, --hide-scrollbars), service worker blocked, reduced motion, animations disabled, caret hidden, fonts and used Manrope/Inter faces loaded before capture.

chipMask.evidence: src/root.styles.ts: controls top = space-18 + space-8 = 26px (line 11), right = space-18 = 18px (line 12), gap = space-8 = 8px (line 17), chip = space-40 + space-4 = 44px square (lines 23-24); src/routes/__root.tsx renders the locale chip then the theme chip (lines 80-155).
chipMask.derivation: Decode the approved Pencil export; paint only the two chip rectangles opaque #FF00FF; encode PNG with the pinned Playwright PNG implementation (e2e/png-mask.ts deriveMaskedPng). The spec paints the same two rectangles with the same color over the actual capture. Baselines are never regenerated from Chromium.

calibration.environment: macOS (Darwin), Playwright 1.64.1 Chromium, pnpm test:e2e e2e/public-homepage-visual.spec.ts, allowance 0 so every nonzero residual is reported by the comparator
calibration.allowancePolicy: Measured ratio rounded up to 0.05pp, plus 0.25pp headroom for Pencil-vs-Chromium rasterization drift across OS (Linux CI measurement not available locally). Geometry probes stay exact and are never widened.
calibration.localization: Residual is text antialiasing/half-pixel placement (Pencil lays out fractional y, Chromium snaps) plus the secondary CTA stroke, which Pencil draws across two rows at 50% coverage and Chromium paints on one row. Flat fills and tokens match exactly.
